source.document: Mordheim Core Rules Printable, Shooting (p15-16) and Close Combat (p18-21) sections

criticalHitChart.label: Hits a vital part
criticalHitChart.description: The wound is doubled to 2 wounds. Roll any armour saves before doubling.

criticalHitChart.label: Hits an exposed spot
criticalHitChart.description: The wound is doubled to 2 wounds. The attack ignores all armour saves.

criticalHitChart.label: Master strike!
criticalHitChart.description: The wound is doubled to 2 wounds. The attack ignores all armour saves. Gain +2 to any Injury rolls.

criticalHitNote: If the attacker normally needs a 6 to wound, he cannot cause a critical hit. Each warrior may only cause one critical hit per hand-to-hand combat phase.

outOfActionChart.label: Knocked Down
outOfActionChart.description: The warrior falls to the ground. Turn the model face up.

outOfActionChart.label: Stunned
outOfActionChart.description: The warrior falls to the ground wounded and barely conscious. Turn the model face down.

outOfActionChart.label: Out of Action
outOfActionChart.description: The warrior is badly hurt and takes no further part in the game. Remove the model.

parryRule: A defender carrying a sword or buckler may, when hit, roll a D6 - a score higher than the attacker's to-hit roll discards that attack entirely. It is impossible to parry a blow that scored a natural 6 to hit. A parry cannot be attempted against an attacker whose Strength is double the defender's own Strength or more. Only one blow per hand-to-hand combat phase may be parried.
knockedDownStunnedRule: Attacks against an already Knocked Down or Stunned model hit automatically - no To Hit roll is made. A Knocked Down model may not parry. If a Stunned model is hit, it is automatically taken Out of Action with no To Wound or armour save roll.

experienceRules.note: Any Hero earns +1 Experience for each enemy he puts out of action - a standard rule repeated across every scenario, not scenario-specific. Henchmen gain experience as a pooled group instead, under separate rules.
